targets.source:
max(
    sum(vm_data_size_bytes{bcs_cluster_id="${bcs_cluster_id}",bk_monitor_namespace="${bk_monitor_namespace}",bk_monitor_name=~"${cluster}-servicemonitor",job=~".*vmstorage.*"}) by(bk_monitor_name, instance) /
    (
        sum(vm_free_disk_space_bytes{bcs_cluster_id="${bcs_cluster_id}",bk_monitor_namespace="${bk_monitor_namespace}",bk_monitor_name=~"${cluster}-servicemonitor",job=~".*vmstorage.*"} - vm_free_disk_space_limit_bytes{bcs_cluster_id="${bcs_cluster_id}",bk_monitor_namespace="${bk_monitor_namespace}",bk_monitor_name=~"${cluster}-servicemonitor",job=~".*vmstorage.*"}) by(bk_monitor_name, instance) +
        sum(vm_data_size_bytes{bcs_cluster_id="${bcs_cluster_id}",bk_monitor_namespace="${bk_monitor_namespace}",bk_monitor_name=~"${cluster}-servicemonitor",job=~".*vmstorage.*"}) by(bk_monitor_name, instance)
    ) 
) by (bk_monitor_name, instance)
